name: visualize
description: Generate beautiful, on-brand HTML artifacts — reports, diagrams, diff reviews, slide decks, plans, recaps, dashboards.

interface.longDescription: visualize lets agents generate self-contained HTML artifacts — reports, diagrams, diff reviews, slide decks, plans, recaps, dashboards — that read as your brand. Captures brand from your codebase, asking, or live site, then applies it consistently across 35 templates and 103 reference design systems. Iteration verbs (polish, review, simplify, bolder, quieter, animate) keep the loop tight. See https://display.dev/docs/visualize for the full feature set.
